map.锡青铜蜗轮+钢蜗杆（油润滑）: Tin bronze worm wheel + steel worm (oil lubricated)
map.青铜蜗轮+钢蜗杆（脂润滑）: Bronze worm wheel + steel worm (grease lubricated)
map.铸铁蜗轮+钢蜗杆: Cast iron worm wheel + steel worm
map.💡 效率 η=tanγ/tan(γ+ρ)，ρ=arctan(μᵥ) 为当量摩擦角: 💡 Efficiency η=tanγ/tan(γ+ρ), where ρ=arctan(μᵥ) is the equivalent friction angle. Self-locking condition: γ ≤ ρ (i.e. η ≤ 0.5).
map.由模数 m、头数 z1、齿数 z2、直径系数 q 求分度圆与中心距。: Find the pitch circles and center distance from the module m, number of starts z1, tooth count z2 and diameter quotient q.
map.导程 pz=π·m·z1 与传动比 i=z2/z1。: Lead pz=π·m·z1 and transmission ratio i=z2/z1.
map.m=4、q=10、z1=1、z2=40：d1=q·m=40 mm、d2=z2·m: m=4, q=10, z1=1, z2=40: d1=q·m=40 mm, d2=z2·m=160 mm; center distance a=(40+160)/2=100 mm; lead pz=π·m·z1=π×4×1=12.57 mm; transmission ratio i=40.
map.z1=2：pz=π×4×2=25.13 mm；i=40/2=20。头数越多导程越: z1=2: pz=π×4×2=25.13 mm; i=40/2=20. The more starts, the larger the lead and the higher the efficiency, but the weaker the self-locking.
map.蜗杆为什么常自锁？: Why are worm drives often self-locking?
map.单头、导程角小于当量摩擦角时自锁（只能蜗杆驱动蜗轮，反向不动），用于起重等防逆转: A single-start worm with a lead angle smaller than the equivalent friction angle is self-locking (only the worm can drive the wheel, not the reverse), used for reversing prevention in hoisting and similar applications.
map.直径系数 q 是什么？: What is the diameter quotient q?
map.q=d1/m，表征蜗杆细长比，影响刚度与加工刀具；标准化以减少滚刀规格。: q=d1/m characterises the worm's slenderness ratio and affects the stiffness and machining tooling; it is standardised to reduce hobbing-cutter specifications.
